notes.title: First footage from the Panzer Dragoon Zwei: Remake demo!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p align="start"][b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b] is here, and on this occasion we’re excited to present the [b]Panzer Dragoon Zwei: Remake [/b]gameplay demo!
 
[b]Watch the demo gameplay:[/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sqAiFFKpjuo"][/dynamiclink]
[b]Panzer Dragoon Zwei: Remake[/b] is a refreshed edition of the second entry in the legendary rail shooter series, taking you into a unique world where ancient ruins, imperial power, and mysterious creatures shape the fate of an entire continent.[/p][p align="start"]
[b]Wishlist Panzer Dragoon Zwei: Remake[/b] [b]on Steam: [/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417530/Panzer_Dragoon_Zwei_Remake/"][/dynamiclink]
 
Step into the role of Jean Jacque Lundi, a young rider who, together with his extraordinary companion - a dragon named Lagi - embarks on a dangerous journey filled with battles, discoveries, and the secrets of ancient civilizations.[/p][p align="start"]The gameplay remains a classic on-rail shooter - fast-paced combat where you strike down enemies with both Lundi’s gun and Lagi’s devastating lasers. With the Berserk Attack at your disposal, even the toughest encounters may turn in your favor.[/p]

notes.title: Get Panzer Dragoon: Remake now with a 90% discount!
notes.content:
A new, remade version of the Panzer Dragoon game – true to the original, with improved graphics and controls, that suit modern gaming standards! On a far, lone planet, you encounter two dragons awaken from the ancient times. Armed with a deadly gun from the past, and the guidance of your armored blue dragon, you must fulfill your destiny and keep the Prototype Dragon from reaching the Tower or die trying.

FEATURES
- Pilot through seven unbelievably realistic levels ranging from tropical blue ocean cities to intricate subterranean ruins.
- Fight the Prototype Dragon who appears together with evil giant dragonflies, frightening man - sized wasps, giant sandworms, and lethal flying battleships.
- Attack enemies approaching from all sides, quickly and without mercy, with improved 360-degree controls and a lock-on targeting.

notes.title: Panzer Dragoon: Remake will launch on PC soon
notes.content:
The dragon combat game of 90s fame is spreading its wings for a PC release soon, the developers say. The Panzer Dragoon: Remake was originally expected last winter and was later released on the Nintendo Switch in March this year, so it’s good to hear that PC date may finally be landing. They’ve not given a date, so we’ll just have to see what flavor of “soon” they mean.

(more…)

notes.title: Panzer Dragoon: Remake is cooming to PC
notes.content:
I appreciate a name like Panzer Dragoon: Remake. It s not shy about what it is, which is a remake of the 1995 Sega Saturn shooter about drago(o)ns. It was announced for the Nintendo Phabuslate earlier this year, but the developers have found the button on their machines that also makes it for the PC, so now we re getting it as well.
